decision: first run of this job writes the trail
one year-independent 500 m photo pyramid recoloured per year on the GPU (detail x era / ref), not a pyramid per year
why: terrain_image.py paints land as photo x smooth ratio, so era/ref is that ratio; per-year z8 sets would be ~120x the bytes and refetch every tile on every scrub
evidence: terrain_image.py frame(); /tmp ratio probe (York ratio 1.75/1.47/2.38, 1900 ratio ~1)

decision: Blue Marble NG 500 m (8 x 21600^2 JPEG) as the fine source, pyramid z3-8
why: 4x finer than the 5400 file; ~1 texel per screen px at z8; below z3 the era image is already <=2 px

decision: skip open-ocean tiles and ship a 256x256 PNG manifest of z8 tiles
why: no 404s, the TileLayer never asks for a missing tile

decision: first full build: 48k tiles, 121 MB for every year, 3 min
why: bounds storage: one set = about one era-year's z8 pyramid

decision: first screenshots showed today's turbid coastal sea on the exposed Ice-Age shelf and a 20 km staircase where detail stops
why: colour-based water test (blue dominance) misses brown/green shallow water; a hard ratio threshold follows bilinear era-pixel blocks

decision: tile alpha = Natural Earth 10m land minus lakes, ramped 0 at today's shore to 255 ~4 km inland
why: a real modern-land mask instead of a colour guess; the ramp hides today's coastline when the sea was lower

decision: photoWeight averaged over 5 taps (0.75 era px) in shader and close3d
why: turns the 20 km staircase at ice and shelf edges into a soft fade

decision: texelOf kind tile-pyramid: tile zoom round(zoom+1) capped at 8, never finer than the photo's 1/240 deg
why: honest texel number; deck.gl 256 px tiles in a 512 px world

decision: overwrote the existing scripts/terrain-shots.mjs by mistake; restored it with git checkout, my script is terrain-detail-shots.mjs
regenerated with land alpha: 47,662 tiles, 138 MB
cache close-3D photoWeight per quarter era pixel per ground tile
why: 5 taps x 3 images per vertex was ~15 bilinear samples per vertex; the weight only changes on the 20 km era grid

decision: threw away the first tiles-off run and reran it at matched load
why: off ran at load 6-16, on at 4-8; tilted times differ 1-2 s from load alone

decision: texel 64->2 px at z8, 256->8 at z10, 1024->32 at z12; tilted z10 cold 6.6->4.9 s; z4 +0.4-0.7 s; tilted fps down up to 15

why: task allows flag-free only with no regression; z4 time to detail and some tilted fps regressed

decision: smoke warns (not fails) while the pyramid is unpublished, checks signatures once the manifest exists
why: code deploys from main before the home-network data publish; a hard check would fail every deploy until then

decision: terrain note says the fine texture is today's ground, imagined; shown only when tiles are on; dropped the stale 'faint line: today's coast' (coast is off by default since 2026-11-20)
